title: Prompt Injection as a Monitor-Disabling Vector: Compounding Agentic Harm

original_idea.body: Build a toy agent loop with an action monitor and inject documents with plain malicious instructions vs malicious-plus-monitor-evasion guidance, measuring monitor catch rate for each.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Injection that disables oversight would collapse defense-in-depth, a concrete agentic-safety chain.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Toy agent loop plus mock tools plus action monitor; clear methodology.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused plain-vs-evasion injection comparison; harness is one dependency.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Self-contained harness, public models, lab-independent infrastructure.

low_compute.reasoning: Open-model inference with mock tools, no training.

novelty.reasoning: Prompt injection studied; injection-as-monitor-disabling-vector may be a fresh angle.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Injection well-studied; the monitor-disabling compound framing may be open.
